excluded_from_discovery.edge_count: calibration/consistency column; tree identity edge_count = order - 1
excluded_from_discovery.degree_sum: calibration/consistency column; handshake identity degree_sum = 2 edge_count
excluded_from_discovery.min_degree: constant 1 on the nontrivial-tree discovery universe
excluded_from_discovery.independence_number: not supplied alongside matching_number because alpha(T)+nu(T)=order for bipartite trees
excluded_from_discovery.radius: diagnostic-only withheld feature; not added after TF1 outcome
excluded_from_discovery.eccentricity_sum: diagnostic-only withheld feature; not added after TF1 outcome
excluded_from_discovery.wiener_index: diagnostic-only withheld feature; not added after TF1 outcome
excluded_from_discovery.cherry_count: diagnostic-only withheld feature; not added after TF1 outcome

txgraffiti.adapter_semantics: TreeForge empty hypothesis payload is normalized to upstream None (always-true base predicate)

anti_numerology: exact discovery-side reevaluation of every machine statement
exact normalized duplicate detection before holdout

candidate_policy.normalization: Use structured TxGraffiti lhs/operator/rhs metadata; preserve raw statement; no post-hoc coefficient tuning.
candidate_policy.duplicate_equivalence: Exact normalized (lhs, operator, rhs) equality only in TF2-0001.
candidate_policy.known_result_filter: Standard calibration identities remain KNOWN_RESULT/ARTIFACT only; no novelty inference.

holdout_policy: Order 12 is generated only after candidate generation and first-stage discovery triage. Order 11 is burned and is not used for TF2 generation, tuning, holdout testing, or adversarial selection.
source_commit_policy: The exact GitHub commit used by the live run is recorded in the manifest and experiment registry. The freeze commit cannot self-contain its resulting SHA; freeze_parent_head fixes the pre-freeze implementation state.
mutation_policy: Any material change to target, features, split, generators, heuristics, post-processors, normalization, candidate cap, or adversarial set closes TF2-0001 and requires a new experiment ID.
